name: Claude forward portfolio (claude-opus-5-5)
source: Fixed monthly prompt run through the Claude Code CLI on 2026-10-05, model claude-opus-5-5. Tracked only from this date.
note: The portfolio is a quality-tilted, lower-volatility version of the S&P 500 built for a better Sharpe ratio. It keeps the core mega-cap AI leaders to limit tracking error and balances them with defensive staples, healthcare, financials and energy to cushion drawdowns over a one-month hold. My knowledge cutoff is June 2026, so I have no prices, earnings results or news from after that date, and these picks do not account for anything that happened between then and 2026-10-05.
